description: Bornes Wi-Fi - Toulouse is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Mairie de Toulouse. Localisation des bornes d'accès Wifi public sur la voie publique ou dans les équipements municipaux sur le territoire de la commune de Toulouse. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Services. Its keywords are wifi, wi-fi, borne, accès, internet, public. The portal shows 94 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
